createTime.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

currentConfigVersion.description_en: The current configuration version number, such as v1. The initial value is v1. The version number increments each time the stack is updated or refreshed and the configuration changes
currentConfigVersion.description_zh: 当前的配置版本号，如：v1。初始值为v1，每次资源栈更新或刷新且配置发生变更时，版本号递增

ramRole.description_en: The RAM role assumed by the system to perform resource change operations during stack deployment
ramRole.description_zh: 资源栈部署过程中由系统扮演角色执行资源变更操作

source.description_en:
The configuration source of the stack. Valid values:
OSS: a template stored in Object Storage Service (OSS).
IAC_SERVICE_MODULE: a template created in the automation service console
source.description_zh:
资源栈的配置来源
OSS ：通过OSS对象存储的模板
IAC_SERVICE_MODULE ： 自动化服务台中创建的模板

sourcePath.description_en:
The path value of the configuration source. The value cannot exceed 1000 characters.
If the source is OSS, the value is in the format of oss::<file link>. The file must be a ZIP file. Example: oss::https://terraform-pipeline.oss-eu-central-1.aliyuncs.com/code.zip.
If the source is IAC_SERVICE_MODULE, the value is a template ID. Example: mod-xxxxx
sourcePath.description_zh:
配置来源的路径值，不超过 1000 个字符
来源为 OSS 时，取值为 oss::<文件链接>，必须为 zip 文件，例如 oss::https://terraform-pipeline.oss-eu-central-1.aliyuncs.com/code.zip
来源为 IAC_SERVICE_MODULE 时，取值为<模板Id>，例如: mod-xxxxx

stackId.description_en: The unique identifier of the stack, which is generated after the stack is created

status.description_en:
The stack status.
| Name | Description |
|------|------|
| Creating | The stack is being created. |
| Created | The stack is created. |
| Waiting | The stack is waiting for deployment. |
| Deploying | The stack is being deployed. |
| Deployed | The stack is deployed. |
| Errored | The deployment failed. |
| Deleting | The stack is being deleted. |
| Deleted | The stack is deleted. |
| DeleteFailed | The deletion failed. |
| DetectTriggered | Drift detection is triggered. |
status.description_zh:
资源栈状态
| 名称 | 描述 |
|------|------|
| Creating | 创建中 |
| Created | 创建完成 |
| Waiting | 等待部署中 |
| Deploying | 部署中 |
| Deployed | 部署完成 |
| Errored | 部署失败 |
| Deleting | 删除中 |
| Deleted | 已删除 |
| DeleteFailed | 删除失败 |
| DetectTriggered | 偏差检测触发成功 |

triggerStrategy.description_en:
The deployment trigger method of the stack. This field is not publicly available.
SetUpdated: triggered by file changes
triggerStrategy.description_zh:
资源栈部署触发方式，暂未对外开放该字段
SetUpdated: 文件变更触发

workingDirectory.description_en: The directory where the deployment and component configuration files of the stack are located. Set this parameter to / for the root directory
workingDirectory.description_zh: stack 的部署和组件配置文件所在的目录，根目录时设置为/
